FAQ.title: FAQ
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you may want to know about working together, my approach, and how I help teams build and grow products.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: I provide software development and technical consulting focused on modern web applications, product development, system modernization, and AI-supported workflows.

items.question: Do you work only as a frontend developer?
items.answer: Frontend is my main specialization, especially React and TypeScript, but I also work on the backend, architecture, product development, and technical consulting.

items.question: Can you help with existing projects?
items.answer: Yes. I often work on existing products: code modernization, maintenance, process optimization, and faster feature delivery.

items.question: What is AI-supported development?
items.answer: It means using modern AI tools to speed up repetitive tasks, research and debugging, prototyping, and shorter delivery times while maintaining engineering quality.

items.question: Do you work with startups?
items.answer: Yes. I enjoy working with startups, especially where fast iteration, pragmatic decisions, and delivery pace matter.

items.question: Can you modernize legacy applications?
items.answer: Yes. I have experience gradually modernizing legacy systems without interrupting ongoing operations.

items.question: Do you offer consulting?
items.answer: Yes. Beyond implementation, I help teams with architecture, scalability, modernization, workflows, and product strategy decisions.

laras.description: Running my own clothing brand: design, branding, e-commerce, logistics, and marketing.

caseStudies.problem: A cohesive brand and online sales channel needed to be built from the ground up.
caseStudies.contribution: I designed the brand's visual identity, launched a PrestaShop-based store, and handled sales and logistics.

caseStudies.problem: New collections required cohesive visual presentation and promotional materials.
caseStudies.contribution: I designed prints, marketing materials, and brand identity elements supporting brand growth.

caseStudies.problem: The brand needed recognizable communication to support online product sales.
caseStudies.contribution: I created social media and promotional campaign materials, ensuring visual communication consistency.

reasonapps.description: Development of a browser-based graphic editor for sports journalists, e-commerce, and maintenance of React on Rails applications.

caseStudies.problem: Sports journalists needed a tool to quickly generate and publish graphics based on live sports event data.
caseStudies.contribution: I co-built an app for automatic graphic generation with Statscore API integration and delivered a Photoshop-inspired graphic editor. I took part in technical consultations and direct client collaboration.

caseStudies.problem: The website of Poland's largest football club required ongoing development and maintenance on a niche React on Rails stack.
caseStudies.contribution: I developed and maintained the application frontend, working with a demanding architecture and supporting platform growth.

caseStudies.problem: The platform needed a scalable frontend architecture and shared components across multiple parts of the system.
caseStudies.contribution: I co-created a monorepo with Yarn Workspaces and Lerna, developed the Next.js application, and integrated a GraphQL API using Hasura GraphQL Engine.

edocs.description: My focus: scalable frontend architecture, component libraries, and performance optimization for large data-driven applications.

caseStudies.problem: The company was developing an advanced system for monitoring production-line processes, processing data from hundreds of devices and electrical receivers.
caseStudies.contribution: I maintained the existing product and co-designed the architecture of a new version for deployment in clients' closed networks. I built the React frontend with a custom Webpack setup, co-created a Rollup-bundled component library documented in Storybook.

caseStudies.problem: The new platform required scalable frontend architecture and the ability to deploy only selected system modules depending on client needs.
caseStudies.contribution: I participated in designing modular frontend architecture with Yarn Workspaces, Lerna, and shared UI components.

caseStudies.problem: The system operated on large volumes of data generated in real time by production environments.
caseStudies.contribution: I worked on interface performance optimization and rendering of large datasets.

global4net.description: React Native mobile applications and modernization of React apps with TypeScript and Redux.

caseStudies.problem: An extensive platform required further development and gradual modernization of the frontend technology stack.
caseStudies.contribution: I initiated TypeScript adoption in the existing codebase, supporting improved typing and application maintainability.

caseStudies.problem: The project required parallel mobile app development and rapid onboarding into the React Native ecosystem.
caseStudies.contribution: I developed a React Native mobile application, quickly adapting to the new environment and supporting product feature development.

caseStudies.problem: A growing application needed simplified data flow and more predictable state management.
caseStudies.contribution: I optimized global application state management and supported further frontend architecture development.

punkta.description: Frontend modernization initiatives, migrating legacy systems to React, stack unification, and UX consistency.

caseStudies.problem: The application ran AngularJS, Vue 1, React on Rails, Webpacker, and global CSS styles in parallel—difficult to maintain and scale.
caseStudies.contribution: I participated in gradual legacy stack reduction and migration of existing business logic to an architecture based on React, SCSS Modules, and Material UI.

caseStudies.problem: An extensive insurance calculator required ongoing development and stability maintenance on a continuously evolving product.
caseStudies.contribution: I developed and maintained key platform features, supporting product growth and implementation of new business requirements.

caseStudies.problem: The purchase process needed improved user experience and reduction of issues affecting conversion.
caseStudies.contribution: I worked on tightening the sales funnel, optimizing interfaces, and improving UX at key stages of the purchase process.

neti.description: Secure business solutions including biometrics, encryption, and Web3 applications.

caseStudies.problem: The project required a secure cryptocurrency wallet enabling conversion to stablecoins, contact management, and convenient fund transfers.
caseStudies.contribution: I co-built a React Native mobile app, developing wallet features and a security system based on PIN, biometrics, and a local Mongo Realm database. I also worked on app UX and secure cryptocurrency transfer handling.

caseStudies.problem: Products needed tools for monitoring and analyzing blockchain data and handling bridging transactions between network layers.
caseStudies.contribution: I developed L2 and L3 block explorers based on Blockscout, built bridging interfaces, and created a Subsquid-based indexer for tracking and processing cross-chain blockchain transactions.

caseStudies.problem: The carbon credits market needed a modern platform for managing and executing emission-offset transactions.
caseStudies.contribution: I co-built the product from scratch using TanStack Start, NestJS, Prisma, and RainbowKit, developing application architecture and blockchain transaction integrations.
